verdict.rationale: Independent reviews say the 9950X3D has the best application performance, beating even the 9950X, along with strong productivity results and gains in Linux developer workloads. None of these isolate single-thread scores, so leadership in lightly-threaded interactive work is implied rather than shown. Missing for 10: explicit single-thread benchmark results (e.g., per-core/ST scores vs. competitors), evidence on interactive responsiveness or latency, and first-party single-thread performance claims.
